subject: english-language
title: Rhetoric Refresher
welcome_lead: Persuasion runs on a small set of repeatable moves.
meta_desc: KS3 English Language adventure on core persuasive techniques.
final_note: You can now name and use core persuasive techniques.

walkthroughs.body_html: 'Don't we deserve clean air?' uses a rhetorical question to push agreement without demanding an answer.
Repetition hammers a point: 'We can do better. We must do better. We will do better.' Three uses also makes a triplet.
Hyperbole exaggerates ('every single household'); a statistic grounds you ('60% of households'). Use both, balanced.
